title: fix(service-datasource): name the reason and the bound objects in the datasource delete refusal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXfJgMndozTHYhLa6rZRghr)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4nPCxmCZ7EzB1A1v

Fixes #30444

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the bound-object refusal keeps `400` `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` and its message, and gains `error.details`; nothing a client reads today moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除一个仍有对象在用的数据源时，拒绝答复除了原来那句英文，还在 `error.details` 里带上机器可读的原因 `objects_bound`、数量和这些对象的名字（排好序的完整列表）。状态码、错误码和英文原句都不变。
- 为什么改：以前拒绝只有一句英文和一个数字，客户端分不清这是哪种 400，也说不出是哪些对象挡着；设置页只能自己再去读对象元数据才能告诉管理员。现在任何客户端（设置页、CLI、API 调用方）都能用自己的语言直接列出对象名。
- 风险与回滚：只加字段，不改已有的字段。名字和数量出自同一次读取，二者不会对不上；元数据读不全时的 503 拒绝原样不动；其他 400 一律不带 `details`，路由只转发自己声明了 400 信封的拒绝的 `details`，驱动错误身上碰巧有 `details` 也不会漏出去。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts` 的 `badRequest`（转发 `details` 的三重条件）；`datasource-admin-service.ts` 的 `boundObjectsError` 与 `removeDatasource`；`datasource-admin-plugin.ts` 的 `countBoundObjectsDiagnosed`（名字与数量同出一次读取）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/admin-routes.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件全绿，其中 `#30444` 一组 5 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule: the bound-object refusal says why and names what is in the way, in `error.details`, from the read that produced its count.**

- **`DatasourceAdminService.removeDatasource` (`@objectstack/service-datasource`).** The bound-object refusal is built by `boundObjectsError`: the same message (`Cannot remove datasource 'NAME': N object(s) are still bound to it.`), plus `code: 'DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR'`, `status: 400` and `details: { reason: 'objects_bound', count, objects }`. `objects` is the full list of bound object names, sorted; no cap (the list is bounded by the objects bound to one datasource).
- **One read.** `DatasourceAdminServiceConfig.countBoundObjectsDiagnosed` may now return `objects?: string[]`, and the plugin wiring returns the names of the same filtered `listObjects()` rows it counts. The count in the message, `details.count` and `details.objects` all come from that one result. ⛔ Not `listObjectsBoundTo`: that is a second scan over another registry (the engine's), and a refusal built from two reads could say "2 objects" and name three. A host that supplies only `countBoundObjects` (no diagnosed read) gets `{ reason, count }` without `objects`.
- **`badRequest` in `admin-routes.ts`.** A thrown error whose `status` is `400`, whose `code` is the route's own `SERVICE_ERROR_CODE[service]` and whose `details` is a plain object is answered with that `details`. All three must hold, the same pattern as the existing `503` and `404` relays, so a driver or library error that carries a stray `details` field keeps answering the bare message. Every other 400 answers exactly as before.
- **`details.reason` spelling.** snake_case, following the envelope's existing `details.reason` values in `plugin-auth` (`invalid_body`, `user_not_found`, `cross_organization`, …) and AGENTS.md's rule for machine-name data values. `service-settings` spells its one reason in kebab-case (`locked-by-env`); this package had no prior `details.reason`.
- **Unchanged:** the status, the code (no new ledger code; `packages/spec` untouched), the English message, the degraded-read refusal (`503` `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `metadataIncompleteError`), the code-defined refusal, the 204 delete. The `IDatasourceAdminService.removeDatasource` docblock names the new `details`. No hand-written doc page states this refusal (searched `content/docs` outside `references/` and `releases/` for the message and the code).

## Why

#30444: the refusal was an English sentence with a count and no machine-readable reason or names, so no client could tell it from any other 400 of this family or name the objects without re-reading metadata (PR #30442 does exactly that in Setup).

## Verification

Measured first, at `6c4c43ab` (real `DatasourceAdminService` + real `registerDatasourceAdminRoutes` on `HonoHttpServer`, a runtime datasource with two bound objects and a code-defined one):

- `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/parts_db` → `400` `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR","message":"Cannot remove datasource 'parts_db': 2 object(s) are still bound to it."}}`, no `details`.
- `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/code_db` → `400` `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR","message":"Datasource 'code_db' is code-defined and cannot be removed at runtime."}}`.
- `badRequest` forwarded the message alone (`sendError(res, 400, code, message)`, no `extra`).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `admin-routes.test.ts` › new top-level describe `DELETE /datasources/:name — the bound-object refusal carries details (#30444)`, over the real service and routes: two bound objects answer `400` `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, the unchanged message and `details { reason: 'objects_bound', count: 2, objects: ['bin', 'part'] }` (sent unsorted; the harness's `listObjectsBoundTo` answers a different name on purpose), and the record survives; a count-only host answers `{ reason, count }`; nothing bound deletes with `204`; the code-defined 400 carries no `details` (exact body); an error with a stray `details` and no 400 envelope answers the bare message (exact body).
- `datasource-removal-bound-count-outage.test.ts` › the plugin-wiring describe: the diagnosed read now also asserts `objects` (`['wh_line', 'wh_order']`), and the predating-`listDiagnosed` case's exact `toEqual` gains `objects: ['wh_order']`. Every other assertion in that file is unchanged and green, the degraded 503 ones included.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: Test Files 71 passed (71), Tests 1174 passed (1174), at `bba4b00f` and again at `f4cc8056` (after merging `main`, 14 commits, none in this package or its route dependencies). `typecheck`: exit 0 (the package tsconfig compiles `src/__tests__`, counted with `--listFiles`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; the suite imports src directly, no build between legs)</summary>

| # | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `badRequest` relays `details` from any error (drop the `status`/`code` conjuncts) | stray-`details` pin red (1 failed) |
| A2 | `badRequest`'s default 400 branch attaches a `details` | code-defined pin, stray-`details` pin and the existing `surfaces lifecycle errors` exact-body pin red (3 failed) |
| A3 | names taken from `listObjectsBoundTo` (a second scan) instead of the count's read | two-bound pin and count-only pin red (2 failed) |
| A4 | `badRequest` stops forwarding `details` | two-bound pin and count-only pin red (2 failed) |

Each mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1); each restore left `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `bba4b00f`: 62 families, the same 62 on `f4cc8056`. All 62 run, exit captured per line before any pipe: 60 exit 0 on the first pass; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (shallow clone, pinned fixture commit fetched, rerun exit 0); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no `dist`, full build under the lock, rerun exit 0). `--ran`: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0 on `f4cc8056`.
- Full dogfood under the verify lock on `bba4b00f` (after a full `turbo run build`): VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 419 passed, 3 skipped (422), Tests 3492 passed, 36 skipped (3528). The merge of `main` adds no file in this package.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The bound-object count (and now the names) comes from the metadata service's `listObjects()`, while `listObjectsBoundTo` reads the engine registry; the plugin's own comment says the former is a boot-time copy that does not see runtime saves. This PR keeps the guard's read as it was (ruling 3: one read, the degraded path untouched) and does not measure whether a runtime-saved object escapes the count. Noted, not filed.
- Once this lands, Setup (PR #30442) may switch from reading object metadata to `error.details.objects`; that is the ui lane's call.
